transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because when I talk, it doesn’t stay lined up right. I’ll start saying something about an overnight shift, and then I’m talking about soccer or paint colors or charts, and people just kind of… look lost.
Does this happen to you all the time when you talk, or are there times when your conversations stay on track?

Not all the time, I guess… but a lot. Especially lately. I’ll try to answer straight and then it just… slips. Like I start with the overnight shift and suddenly I’m on soccer or paint colors or charts, and people don’t follow.
Do you feel like your thoughts are disconnected or hard to follow when this happens?

Yeah… kind of. It’s like my words don’t stay in a straight line. I’ll start on one thing, like the overnight shift, and then I’m suddenly talking about soccer or paint colors or charts. I can tell people get lost.
Do you feel like these difficulties with your conversations are causing you any problems or distress?

Yeah… it’s causing problems. At work people have had to double-check my rounds and charting, which is embarrassing. And at home I’m behind on bills, I don’t really answer friends, and my apartment’s… bad.

It got bad enough that employee health sent me for an emergency evaluation after I told them I was thinking about suicide.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people can't hear?
I… I’m not really sure. I don’t think so. Sometimes I hear stuff and then when I check, there’s nothing, but I don’t know if that’s just me being tired or the building noises.
Have you recently experienced a period where you felt extremely happy, energetic, or irritable?
I don’t know… not really. I wouldn’t say extremely happy or energetic. Irritable, maybe, but… I’m not sure it’s like that.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely happy or energetic for a long time?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times where I was in a better mood, I guess, but not like extremely happy or full of energy for a long time.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it just feels… heavy. Empty, I guess. Sometimes after work I just sit in my car and cry for a while before I can drive home.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't need much sleep and still felt rested?
Not really… I don’t think so. If I don’t sleep much, I usually feel pretty bad the next day.
Do you ever believe things that might not be true, even when other people tell you they're not?

Yeah… maybe. I mean, at work I’m pretty sure my supervisors are changing my shifts on purpose, and watching me on the unit cameras… like checking if I’m unsafe or something. People keep saying it’s just staffing shortages, but I don’t really buy that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely irritable for a long time?
I don’t know… I get annoyed sometimes, but not like a long stretch where it felt extreme. Not that I can think of.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely energetic or irritable and also didn't need much sleep?
No… I don’t think I’ve had that. If I’m not sleeping, I don’t feel energetic. I just feel worn out.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely energetic or happy and also felt like you could do a lot more things than you normally can?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times where I tried to get things done, but not like I felt unusually happy or like I could do everything.
Have you ever felt extremely happy or energetic for several days in a row?
No… not really. I can’t think of a time where I felt like that for days.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah… I guess. I used to sketch murals, cook for friends, play soccer on weekends… stuff like that. Now it just feels kind of pointless, so I mostly ignore messages and stay in my apartment.
Do you really believe your supervisors are changing your shifts on purpose and watching you, even when others say it's not true?

Yeah… I mean, I know people say it’s just staffing, but it doesn’t feel random. I’m pretty sure they’re moving my shifts around on purpose… and watching me on the unit cameras, like they’re checking if I’m unsafe or something.
Do you still believe your supervisors are watching you on cameras?
Yeah… I still think they are. I know people keep saying it’s staffing issues, but it doesn’t feel like that. The shift changes and the cameras… it feels like they’re checking if I’m unsafe.
Do you still think your supervisors are watching you on cameras?
Yeah. I know I already said it, but… yeah, I still think they are. The cameras and the shift changes don’t feel like a coincidence. It feels like they’re checking if I’m unsafe.
Do you still think your supervisors are watching you on cameras?
Yeah… I do. I know I’ve said it already, but I’m sure they’re using the unit cameras to keep an eye on me… like to see if I’m unsafe. It doesn’t feel like it’s just staffing.
Do you still think your supervisors are watching you on cameras for no reason?
Not for no reason. I think… I think they changed my shifts and use the cameras to watch me, to see if I’m unsafe. People say it’s just staffing shortages, but I don’t really buy that.
